column1: # Static carrier inventory for the canonical persisted block_signatures_simplex_pq#13 BOC,
# the deterministic node/lite SignatureSet schema projections, and the still-unavailable
# complete production objects. These are not live carrier round trips.
# Deferred owner: the unit that adds the PQ TL variants and checked parser must match the
# projected sizes byte-for-byte, then put complete finality-broadcast and lite forward-proof
# objects at 21 and 100 signers through the real generated serializers and admission checks.
# A mismatch reopens the frozen persisted-envelope decision.
# Lite-gate implementer note: despite the design text mentioning RLDP max_answer_size, this tree's
# production lite client uses AdnlExtClient::send_query over framed TCP and does not use RLDP on
# this path. Build the later gate against the actual route unless production routing changes.
